## 5.1 源端站点管理 (source-site management)

Documented purpose: the source site caches the basic data of the V2V source platform, and that basic data is automatically synchronized once every 5 minutes (「源端站目标的是为了缓存V2V 源端平台的基础数据，基础数据的同步每5 分钟自动同步一次」).

### 5.1.1 新增源端站点



```text

5.1.2 同步源端站点
这是一个异步接口，执行后会立刻触发同步动作
```



That is, the `type` parameter of the add-source-site interface currently accepts the values VMWARE and CNWARE.

### 5.1.2 同步源端站点

This is an asynchronous interface; executing it immediately triggers a synchronization action (「这是一个异步接口，执行后会立刻触发同步动作」).

### 5.2.3 策略部署

Through this interface the migrating virtual machine's host, storage and network input parameters are calculated from the deployment parameters. Documented calculation logic: host is matched first (优先匹配主机), shared storage is matched on the basis of the host, and the port group is matched on the basis of vlanid. Documented caveat: when the host satisfies the conditions, storage and port group may return empty values, which the caller must handle itself (「注：主机满足条件的情况下，存储和端口组可能会返回空值，需要自行处理」).

## Platform-, version- and capability-related conditions recorded in 5.4

Labelled synthesis; premises are the error messages listed above, which the source states as error text rather than as a normative prerequisites checklist.

- Platform version: 900044 「不支持相同版本的管理平台」 — a management platform of the same version is not supported (i.e. the documented restriction concerns same-version management platforms).
- Target host architecture: 900131 — migration onto a non-X86-architecture physical host is not supported.
- Source platform specifics: 900104 — a virtual machine on vCenter 6.0 using NFS storage is not supported for migration; 900103 — a virtual machine configured with an SR-IOV passthrough NIC cannot migrate; 900010, 900101 and 900102 describe connection requirements to VCenter/ESXi hosts (ESXi port 902, VCenter port 443).
- CBT and snapshot preconditions: 900002 (CBT cannot be enabled; the VM may not support this configuration), 900003 (CBT configuration cannot be cancelled), 900015 (VM does not support CBT configuration), 900016 (no snapshot may exist), with 900011/900012 covering snapshot inconsistency or loss.
- Device/image preconditions: 900117 (a file is mounted in the VM's optical drive and must be unmounted before retry), 900018 (disk type must not be an independent type), 900027 (unsupported disk type).
- Guest adaptation for IP configuration: 900105 (IP configuration not yet adapted for the given OS type), 900028 (no Tools installed, IP cannot be configured), 900046 (Tools did not start within the expected time, IP cannot be set), 900047 (IP setting failed).
- Source-site errors concern 900108–900116 (existence, occupancy by a migration task, deletion failure, duplicate name, malformed IP, creation failure, empty/blank values, connection failure); see also 900139.
- Resource-capacity errors concern 900051 (required CPU count exceeds available CPU total), 900066 (storage pool free capacity insufficient), 900120 (target host free memory insufficient) and 900121 (vCPU cannot exceed the host's logical CPUs).
- Task-state and scheduling errors concern 900019–900022, 900137 and 900142–900147 (task existence, running/finished/cancelled states, task start time and switch time updates, with start/switch times required to be more than one minute later than the current time where stated).

The chapter gives no other documented criterion for which source/target platform combinations are supported beyond these messages and the `type` values VMWARE and CNWARE noted under 5.1.1.

## Preceding error messages on printed page 107

The window begins inside the preceding chapter and, immediately before the 第6章 heading, carries three numbered error-message templates:



```text

第107页
900148=虚拟机【{0}】更新任务开始时间与切换时间冲突，切换时间必须大于开始时间
900149=虚拟机【{0}】更新任务开始时间失败，只有创建时配置开始时间才支持更新开始时
间
900150=虚拟机【{0}】更新任务切换时间失败，只有创建时配置切换时间才支持更新切换时
间
```



These entries concern updating a virtual machine (虚拟机【{0}】) task's start time (开始时间) and switch time (切换时间), a schedule/update concern that belongs with the virtual machine's task state handling ([[concepts/virtual-machine-lifecycle]]):

- `900148` reports a conflict between the task's start time and switch time, and requires the switch time to be later than the start time.

## Scope and reading limits

The chapter documents four parts: 5.1 源端站点管理, 5.2 迁移任务, 5.3 迁移任务状态 and 5.4 异常描述.

The supplied window ends at physical page 118 (printed page 106); the chapter's recorded native page span runs to physical page 127, so physical pages 119–127 were not read. Within the chapter, per-interface request/response parameter tables are supplied as figure images (for example `sources/images/CNware-WinStack-V9-4-0-接口开发指南/p108_img119.png`); those pixels were not interpreted here, so parameter names and values beyond the prose notes transcribed below are not reproduced.

## 5.1 源端站点管理 (source-site management)

Documented purpose: the source site caches the basic data of the V2V source platform, and that basic data is automatically synchronized once every 5 minutes (「源端站目标的是为了缓存V2V 源端平台的基础数据，基础数据的同步每5 分钟自动同步一次」).

### 5.1.1 新增源端站点



```text
type 参数目前支持 VMWARE 以及CNWARE 两种类型
5.1.2 同步源端站点
这是一个异步接口，执行后会立刻触发同步动作
```



That is, the `type` parameter of the add-source-site interface currently accepts the values VMWARE and CNWARE.

### 5.1.2 同步源端站点

This is an asynchronous interface; executing it immediately triggers a synchronization action (「这是一个异步接口，执行后会立刻触发同步动作」).

## 5.2 迁移任务 (migration tasks)

### 5.2.1 获取迁移主机列表

Supports POST- and GET-type queries (「支持POST 和GET 类型的查询」).

### 5.2.2 获取虚拟机列表

Supports POST- and GET-type queries (「支持POST 和GET 类型的查询」).

### 5.2.3 策略部署

Through this interface the migrating virtual machine's host, storage and network input parameters are calculated from the deployment parameters. Documented calculation logic: host is matched first (优先匹配主机), shared storage is matched on the basis of the host, and the port group is matched on the basis of vlanid. Documented caveat: when the host satisfies the conditions, storage and port group may return empty values, which the caller must handle itself (「注：主机满足条件的情况下，存储和端口组可能会返回空值，需要自行处理」).

### 5.2.4 迁移任务前置检查

This interface is executed before creating a task, to perform the necessary-condition pre-check of the task (「创建任务前执行该接口进行任务的必要条件预检查」).

### 5.2.5 新增迁移任务

Documented prerequisite: before using this interface, first become familiar with the virtual-machine creation logic, because the V2V migration interface's base parameters are configured on the basis of virtual-machine creation (「查看该接口时请先熟悉虚拟机创建的相关逻辑，V2V 迁移接口基参数基于虚拟机创建进行参数设置」). See [[concepts/virtual-machine-lifecycle]].

Highlighted parameter: `switchType`, which determines the execution type of the task.



```text
重点关注参数switchType，这个参数决定了任务的执行类型
```



### 5.2.6 查询迁移任务详情

Interface for querying migration-task details.

### 5.2.7 批量切换任务



```text
需要注意的是
切换的任务当且仅当只有READY_END 以及INC_END 两个状态可以执行切换
```



That is, switching may be executed only for tasks whose status is READY_END or INC_END.

### 5.2.8 重新发起迁移任务

Interface for re-initiating a migration task.

### 5.2.9 取消迁移任务



```text
注：当迁移任务正在执行迁移数据的动作时，取消接口的响应时间会较长
5.3 迁移任务状态
V2V 迁移的任务分别有5 个阶段 
```



That is, while a migration task is performing the data-migration action, the cancel interface's response time is longer.

V2V migration tasks have 5 stages (「V2V 迁移的任务分别有5 个阶段」). Table as supplied, with native headers 状态值(status) | 说明 | 阶段（stepIndex）; the table spans physical pages 112–113.

## Platform-, version- and capability-related conditions recorded in 5.4

Labelled synthesis; premises are the error messages listed above, which the source states as error text rather than as a normative prerequisites checklist.

- Platform version: 900044 「不支持相同版本的管理平台」 — a management platform of the same version is not supported (i.e. the documented restriction concerns same-version management platforms).
- Target host architecture: 900131 — migration onto a non-X86-architecture physical host is not supported.
- Source platform specifics: 900104 — a virtual machine on vCenter 6.0 using NFS storage is not supported for migration; 900103 — a virtual machine configured with an SR-IOV passthrough NIC cannot migrate; 900010, 900101 and 900102 describe connection requirements to VCenter/ESXi hosts (ESXi port 902, VCenter port 443).
- CBT and snapshot preconditions: 900002 (CBT cannot be enabled; the VM may not support this configuration), 900003 (CBT configuration cannot be cancelled), 900015 (VM does not support CBT configuration), 900016 (no snapshot may exist), with 900011/900012 covering snapshot inconsistency or loss.
- Device/image preconditions: 900117 (a file is mounted in the VM's optical drive and must be unmounted before retry), 900018 (disk type must not be an independent type), 900027 (unsupported disk type).
- Guest adaptation for IP configuration: 900105 (IP configuration not yet adapted for the given OS type), 900028 (no Tools installed, IP cannot be configured), 900046 (Tools did not start within the expected time, IP cannot be set), 900047 (IP setting failed).
- Source-site errors concern 900108–900116 (existence, occupancy by a migration task, deletion failure, duplicate name, malformed IP, creation failure, empty/blank values, connection failure); see also 900139.
- Resource-capacity errors concern 900051 (required CPU count exceeds available CPU total), 900066 (storage pool free capacity insufficient), 900120 (target host free memory insufficient) and 900121 (vCPU cannot exceed the host's logical CPUs).
- Task-state and scheduling errors concern 900019–900022, 900137 and 900142–900147 (task existence, running/finished/cancelled states, task start time and switch time updates, with start/switch times required to be more than one minute later than the current time where stated).

The chapter gives no other documented criterion for which source/target platform combinations are supported beyond these messages and the `type` values VMWARE and CNWARE noted under 5.1.1.

## 4.1.7 接口7:部署虚拟机 — 4.1.7.1 参数概要 (physical page 39)

The parameter summary (physical page 39) enumerates the parts of the deploy request body:

- `baseInfo` — 虚拟机基本信息, which "包含了虚拟机名称(name), vmHostName, cpu 和内存(memory)等";
- `diskDevices` — 磁盘集合;
- `bridgeInterfaces` — 网卡集合;
- `cloudInitReq` — given the note "需要使用 cloud init 进行处理虚拟机的脚本是使用", i.e. this member is used when a virtual machine's script requires cloud-init processing.

The accompanying request skeleton shows the member as a nested object inside the request body, given in the source only in the abbreviated form (the body of the object is not spelled out on this page):

`"cloudInitReq": { ... }`

### Conditions and limits recorded on the covered pages

- The covered pages give no default value, data type, mandatory/optional status, or field-level structure for `cloudInitReq` beyond the description quoted above; the object's inner content is left as an ellipsis in the source example.
- No statement in the covered pages assigns cloud-init any further role (for example in image preparation, disk handling or post-deploy configuration); such statements, if present in the guide, lie outside this read.

### Reading scope

This contribution is grounded in physical pages 37–55 (printed pages 25–43) of the source, covering section 4.1.6's tail, the deploy interface heading and parameter summary 4.1.7.1–4.1.7.8, and examples through physical page 55. The source records a continuation past page 56 and a native page range of 37–68, so later statements about cloud-init in this document are not addressed here.

**cloud-init** is the name under which *CNware WinStack V9.4.0 接口开发指南* records the virtual-machine customization facility that a VM deployment request configures; the guide's own section for it is §4.1.7.9 虚拟机使用cloud init (第47页; physical page 59). Within the supplied pages the guide documents the platform-side script-upload interface and the `cloudInitReq` deployment parameters, not cloud-init itself.
